topic: Show Member Detail Filter (Admission Leads Page)
summary: The 'Show Member Detail' filter on the Admission Leads page allows a team leader to view not only their own leads but also the combined lead data of all counselors under their team. This provides a comprehensive overview of the team's lead pipeline.
steps: 3. Select the desired 'Team Leader' from the counselor filter.
4. Toggle the 'Show Member Detail' option to 'On'.
5. Click 'Go' to apply the filter and view the combined lead data.
business_rules: When 'Show Member Detail' is 'Off', only the individual leads assigned to the selected counselor (or team leader) are displayed.
When 'Show Member Detail' is 'On', the system displays all leads assigned to the selected counselor (or team leader) AND all leads assigned to their team members.
important_notes: This filter is a critical tool for team leaders to monitor their team's overall performance, lead engagement, and progress.
It helps in understanding the collective workload and pipeline of the team.
questions: How can a team leader view all the leads managed by their team members?
What is the function of the 'Show Member Detail' filter?
What is the difference in lead visibility when 'Show Member Detail' is on versus off?
Is this filter available to all counselors or only team leaders?
How does this filter help in team performance monitoring?
